items.title: Kojak 2005 (Part 2)
items.description: <div>Ving Rhames (Mission Impossible) portrays Lieutenant Theo Kojak of the New York City Police Department, a skilled plain clothes detective with a shaved head and an affinity for jazz, fine clothing, and lollipops. As in the original Kojak, he is fond of the catchphrase "Who loves ya, baby?"</div
